'''Midnight Hall''' was the base of operations for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was located inside the [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] [[Sinharan T'sau]] orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="JT" />
